entities.name: Riolla Hifrata
entities.description: A crime boss of the merchant caste in Sumifa living in Almaaz in 3050 AR.

entities.name: Sumifa
entities.description: City of which Riolla was a crime boss.

entities.name: Maceo
entities.description: Thedeso's son, who inherited the throne and agreed to betroth Riolla.

entities.name: Claria
entities.description: Maceo's former betrothed, who sought the crystals of Sarraza.

entities.name: Porros
entities.description: Sand wraith for whom Riolla secretly worked.

entities.name: Ogwater Rifkin
entities.description: Songmage and former lover of Riolla who released the Beast of the Hours and completed the banishing spell.

entities.name: Beast of the Hours
entities.description: Monster released from its prison and banished.

entities.name: Womba
entities.description: Orc killed by the Beast of the Hours.

events.summary: After Thedeso dies, Riolla promises Maceo wealth if he betroths her; he agrees and casts off Claria.
events.quote: Maceo agreed, casting off his former betrothed, Claria

events.summary: Riolla learns Cheyne and Ogwater joined Claria in seeking the crystals of Sarraza and greedily follows them.
events.quote: Riolla greedily followed them, thinking the vault had a large treasure.

events.summary: Ogwater releases the Beast of the Hours, which kills Womba.
events.quote: Ogwater released the Beast of the Hours from its prison

events.summary: Riolla gives Ogwater her black pearl, the last stone to complete the banishing spell, then returns empty-handed.
events.quote: Riolla gave the songmage her black pearl, the last stone he needed to complete the spell

relations.note: Secretly worked for the sand wraith
relations.quote: Secretly working for the sand wraith Porros
his son Maceo inherited the throne
